def: OpenAI's frontier safety framework, which tracks biological and chemical, cybersecurity and AI self-improvement capabilities against High and Critical thresholds that require matching safeguards.
practice: Version 2 (April 2025) is current as of November 2026; in September 2026 OpenAI rated a model, Astra, Critical in cybersecurity for the first time and withheld its full cyber capabilities from wide release.
